description: This file defines the FileObject class, which generates and manages file attributes for malware analysis, including hashing, entropy calculation, and MIME type detection.

classes.name: FileObject
classes.description: A class for representing and extracting attributes from a file, including hashing, MIME type, and entropy.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a FileObject instance, reading file data from a path or BytesIO, and setting up attributes.

methods.name: generate_attributes
methods.description: Generates file attributes such as filename, size, hashes, entropy, and MIME type.

methods.name: __entropy_H
methods.description: Calculates the entropy of a data buffer.
